title: NGX View Builder view (1.0.0-rc.0)
description: A view for @ngxviewbuilder/runtime: pages lay out rows of columns, each column places one element by name.

settings.description: View settings: width, language, render mode, variables, rules, process.

column.description: One cell of a row. elementRef names an element in `elements` (or in the template of the panel the row belongs to).

tabRows.description: Children of tabs, accordions and steps, per tab.

type.description: required, minlength, maxlength, min, max, pattern, email, strictoptions, custom, or a registered type.

condition.description: Expression for a custom validator: true means valid.

applyIf.description: Expression: the validator runs only while it is true.

sectionMode.description: Use as page section. Full width band with its own background, content centred at a readable width. Build web pages from sections, best with the Canvas render mode.

sectionContentWidth.description: Content width. Maximum width of the content inside the band. Default 1120px.

sectionPaddingY.description: Space above and below. Default grows with the screen: 48px on phones up to 96px on wide screens.

sectionMinHeight.description: Minimum height. For a hero band, e.g. 480px or 80vh.

backgroundOverlayColor.description: Image overlay. A colour over the image keeps text readable, e.g. rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45).
